source_text.body:
Fill repetitive forms from spreadsheet values
A user has Operator fill out repetitive forms using values from a spreadsheet; it runs slower than expected but saves a lot of time.
·
May 2, 2025
Done with
OP
Operator
What they did
One commenter says they use Operator for a repetitive form that has to be filled from values in a spreadsheet. From the thread, the setup is basically browser automation for that one workflow: Operator handles the repeated entry work, while the person decides to use it for that specific task rather than broader automation.
How it went
They say it is slower than expected, but it still gets the job done, saves a ton of time, and is worth it for them. The limitation is that this was the only use case they found worthwhile.
Worth knowing
The main catch is speed: the user says Operator moved slower than they expected.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Open my spreadsheet at [link] and use each row to fill out the form at [form URL], one submission per row. Start with the first row only and show me the filled form before submitting it. After I approve, continue through the remaining rows, pausing before each submit unless I say otherwise, and stop when every row is done, then tell me which ones were submitted.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPTPro/comments/1kd1sar
